output.reason: The changelog [ev-4e830661fba0] and the PR [ev-81363509bba4] support the "deprecated" change type: the PR adds a deprecation note and says the cache cannot be fully removed yet because legacy indexes still rely on it. However, none of the evidence names the configuration key. The PR touched pkg/storage/config/store.go and docs/sources/configure/_index.md [ev-6da8b21de058], but neither excerpt shows the key name or where it sits in the config, so the path "write_dedupe_cache" cannot be checked. The protocol-behavior family in P1 is also wrong, because this is a setting, not wire behaviour. To decide the subject, we need the content of the configure docs or the store.go diff showing the exact YAML key or flag.
